claims.text: 20 hours can move to the following weeks, where slack is confirmed.
claims.limit: Synthetic didactic data (Marco, Appendix E); not an observation of any real institution.

chain.if: we adopt shared priority criteria applied by each university and coordinate only the conflicts
chain.then: conflicting bookings fall and priority projects get their hours
chain.because: members stop over-reserving defensively once the criteria are predictable and appealable
provided_that: essential demand stays within 90 ordinary hours
deferred hours fit the confirmed slack
chain.final_result: priority projects completed on time and members still value the consortium

rivals.explanation: Demand that cannot be deferred exceeds capacity, so no rule removes the conflict.
rivals.discriminating_evidence: essential demand above 90 hours in consecutive cycles despite applied criteria

rivals.explanation: Duplicate or stale reservations inflate the apparent demand.
rivals.discriminating_evidence: reconciliation of active requests against projects shows duplicates

refutations.observation: conflicts do not fall after two cycles of applied criteria
